description.en-US: The group this condition belongs to. Conditions within one group are ANDed; the groups are ORed with each other (D-06). That sum-of-products shape expresses every example in BR 23 and needs no expression parser.

What this condition tests (BR 23). Customer and customer group are explicitly future in BR 23 and are deliberately absent: adding them now would mean an enum value nothing evaluates, which reads as a supported feature that silently never matches.

How the condition compares. in and not_in read their set from sales_promotion_condition_targets rather than from a column, because a set of variant ids has no sensible single-column representation (D-07).

The comparison value when it is textual - a day name, a channel code. Typed columns rather than free-form JSON (D-07): eligibility is queried as 'which programs might apply to this cart', and JSON would make that a full table scan.
The comparison value when it is numeric - a subtotal threshold, a quantity. Scale 6 covers both money at D-01 scale and fractional quantities.
The lower bound of a between comparison, inclusive. Unused by every other operator.

The upper bound of a between comparison, inclusive - unlike the validity windows elsewhere in this module, which are exclusive. A quantity range of 'between 5 and 10' means a customer buying exactly 10 qualifies, which is what an operator writing that expects.
